name: Ante Kovačić
bio:
Ante Kovačić's journey in motorsport began in his youth, fueled by a passion for engineering and racing. He earned a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Zagreb before dedicating himself to a career in motorsport. Ante started in junior formulas, working his way up through the ranks, gaining experience in vehicle dynamics and race strategy, and eventually becoming a sporting director.

His approach to the role is characterized by a commitment to precision and efficiency. He believes that success in motorsport hinges on meticulous planning and seamless execution, and he is driven to foster a culture of excellence within his team. Ante is known for his analytical skills and his ability to make critical decisions under pressure. He has a track record of success in competitive environments and is known for his unwavering dedication to the team's goals. He's a firm believer in data-driven decisions, and is rarely swayed by emotion.

physical.description: Ante is of average height with a slightly athletic build, and carries himself with a serious demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out timing sheet from a past race, claiming it brings him luck.
Has a specific brand of coffee he insists on having before every race.
Muttering race strategy scenarios under his breath when nervous
